# Selvala Win-Rate Build Manifest — Synthesis of Five Surveys

**Overriding frame (respected throughout):** combos are PROVEN (33 gates green). The frontier is **ASSEMBLY → CONVERSION → RESILIENCE**, not more infinite combos. The measured reality (SELVALA-ARC smoke30, seed 3033) is **1/30 wins, ~21/30 dispatches abort on `piece_lost`, the one loop that ran fired `spell_cast=0`** — the pieces never reach the battlefield.

**Assumed-existing dependency — NOT in this manifest:** the **assemble-and-deploy phase for program combos** (`programPreAssembly` / deploy-driver: cast Staff/Umbral from hand, equip toward `on_battlefield`/`attached` preconditions) is being built in parallel. Two surveys independently reconstructed it (assembly-accel Target A, reconcile #1); I do **not** re-propose it. Items below marked **[⊕deploy]** depend on or amplify it — their real lift is gated on it landing. Build them anyway (owner directive: build the whole set out, then test).

## 3. Already Covered — Do NOT Rebuild (mechanism cited)

- **Genesis Wave outlet** — `SelvalaManaLoopRunner.chooseOutlet()` rung 1 (@507-519): force-casts X = `library-35`, bypasses Forge's `NeedsToPlayVar` gate. Reserve tuning explicitly closed by owner (ARC "RESERVE DECISION"). 3/3 anchor + 4/4 sweep gates.
- **bounce_recur family** — `BounceRecurRunner.java` + `combo-program-ben-ewit-sabertooth-defiler/-henge/-kogla-sabertooth.json`, dispatched via `"bounce_recur".equals(programClass)` and steered by `pendingRecurBounce`. This is Selvala's Giada-class pairing; it exists.
- **Cast Selvala early / commander ramp** — `ComboPilot.preAssembly()` (PR-26 @1092-1117) casts COMMAND-zone pieces once affordable; `entryRunway()` (PR-30 @1194-1214) prefers hand mana-producers; both gate on `hasBoundCombo` incl. `programPaths`.
- **Sweep land-untap target** — programs hardcode `"target":"Gaea's Cradle"` in `untap_sequence`; sweepC/D convert (X=55 → 57-58 permanents).
- **`lethalAlphaOrder()`** (PR-34 @1494) — general guaranteed-kill check, sickness-aware via `CombatUtil.canAttack`, already fires unconditionally.
- **`programAssembled()` gate** (@288-310) — the *defensive* precondition check exists (collapsed aborts 22→4); its *offensive* counterpart is the parallel assembly-deploy workstream, not a manifest item.
- **`PairedPlayFinder` / `PairingRunner` (wipe+shield)** — `paired-plays.json: []` is a **correct, permanent** result; `grep "destroy all|exile all"` → 0 hits. Do not tune the finder for Selvala.
- **Tutor-priorities weighting + generic ramp pipeline** — verified in good shape and already general.

**True dead-ends (no action):** Genesis Hydra outlet (strictly dominated by Goldvein — no haste); cost-reduction for Staff/Umbral (no card in the 99 reduces colorless-artifact cost — assembly-accel E); Nylea / Ojer Kaslem / Polukranos / Return of the Wildspeaker / Garruk ult as outlets (dig, single-fire, or non-scaling); Walking Ballista / Helix Pinnacle / Torment of Hailfire (not in the 99).

## 4. Build Order (dependencies first; efficient full build-out, not early lift)

**Wave 0 — Doc-hygiene + zero-dep prep (unblocks later waves, cheap)**
- C3 Target-C doc → **gate:** doc reads DONE, no dangling spec.
- C4 program-backlog reconcile → **gate:** backlog matches live compiled programs.
- C1 `protection-priorities.json` emitter → **gate:** artifact emitted with scope for all 7 protection cards *(blocks B1)*.
- C2 TutorWeights protection class → **gate:** Allosaurus + Dosan appear in `tutor-priorities.json` weights.

**Wave 1 — Outlet-ladder & conversion (all inside `SelvalaManaLoopRunner`; do together)**
- A1 Goldvein Hydra rung → **gate:** new gate — Goldvein fires and wins when `pool-1 ≥ Σ opp life`.
- A2 Finale→Craterhoof pin → **gate:** Finale names Craterhoof as fetch target when reachable & CMC 8 ≤ X.
- A4 Craterhoof-from-hand gate → **gate:** last rung skipped on <4-creature board.
- A3 Rhonas pump-loop terminal → **gate:** new terminal pumps to lethal vs a single opponent; gate green.
- A6 restricted-mana awareness → **gate:** creature-only/legendary-only mana excluded from generic outlet X sizing.
- A7 Omnath retention → **gate:** with Omnath out, banked green persists across the phase in sizing.
- A5 haste wiring (T1) → **gate:** `program_complete` sets `currentRoute`; `combatOrder`/`lethalAlphaOrder` produces a lethal alpha the flip turn in a gate.

**Wave 2 — Pairing-finder (independent prep)**
- D1 `BounceRecurFinder` → **gate:** finder re-emits the 3 hand-authored programs from card data alone (regression parity) + surfaces any new candidate.

**Wave 3 — Tutor/assembly amplifiers [⊕deploy] (land alongside the parallel deploy phase)**
- B6 Inventors' Fair activated-ability tutor → **gate:** `findCastableTutor` returns Inventors' Fair when 3+ artifacts + a missing artifact piece.
- B7 tutor routing by card-type (T6) → **gate:** a creature-only tutor is not selected while the missing piece is an artifact.
- B8 mulligan keep by tutor-weight (C) → **gate:** Staff-in-hand kept, Satyr-only hand mulliganed at equal land counts.

**Wave 4 — Pilot protection / resilience (reactive; real lift [⊕deploy])**
- B1 reactive protect-the-piece (R1) → **gate:** opponent removal targeting Selvala mid-loop triggers Heroic Intervention/Boots before priority passes *(consumes C1)*.
- B2 equip-in-response (R4) → **gate:** Greaves/Boots equip-in-response fizzles a targeted removal.
- B3 equip hazard guard (T7) → **gate:** deploy/protect picks Swiftfoot Boots over Greaves while Umbral equip is still pending.
- B4 proactive Asceticism (R5) → **gate:** Asceticism cast on curve when drawn and affordable.
- B5 pre-loop green-light gate (T9) → **gate:** loop defers the outlet when an opponent holds open mana and no Dosan/uncounterable cover is live.
- B9 sac-target discipline (T8) → **gate:** Greater Good sacs the intended creature.

**Wave 5 — Optional generalization (only if Wave-4 B1 proves insufficient)**
- X1 fuller reactive-shield primitive → **gate:** general stack-watch shield covers a targeted linchpin that no runner currently owns.

**Sequencing note (honest):** every outlet/conversion item (Wave 1) and every protection item (Wave 4) is a multiplier on a base rate the parallel **assemble-and-deploy** phase must first lift off ~0 — smoke30 shows the loop entered the runner once in 30 games and cast its outlet zero times. Building the full set out now is correct per the owner directive; just expect the measurable win-rate movement to appear only after deploy lands and the loop starts dispatching. The single item with standalone value *before* deploy is B1's narrow case — protecting Selvala herself the turn she first resolves (no loop state required).
